text: On September 9, 2019 an application was submitted to the Strategic Partnerships division (formerly referred to as the Toronto Office of Partnerships) requesting to name baseball diamond #1 at Stan Wadlow Park to Harry MacAloney Field. Baseball diamond #1 is the largest baseball diamond at the park, situated in the north-east corner of the park. The results of the public consultation survey determined that the majority of respondents were in favour of the naming.
The Toronto East York Community Council: 1. Adopted the naming of the baseball diamond field #1, located at 373 Cedarvale Avenue to Harry MacAloney Field.
